title: Someone is freaking out…
summary: Salesforce is retiring SOAP API login() in June 2027 and Platform API versions 31-40 in 2028. It's going to be wild.
body_markdown:
Salesforce is retiring SOAP API` login()` in Summer ’27.


Another reminder that every integration eventually becomes archaeology.


Somewhere out there, a developer is about to discover a mission-critical process running on 12-year-old XML and pure determination.
